title: 第二百一十二章 前往抗疫第一线第二百一十一章 牛寨村闹瘟疫了
content_zh:
第二百一十二章前往抗疫第一线！
王大壮和孙菲菲对视了一眼。
没有多余的交流，也不需要商量——
王大壮看出对方的意思，于是率先开了口道：“王老师，我们也留下来，一起共同对抗这场瘟疫。”
王老师看着他们，沉默了片刻，最终点了点头，透着欣慰道：“好，中医有你们这一代人，我们也是感到十分欣慰，那这样，明天一早出发，你们做好准备。”
“王老师，我们没问题，这就去收拾。”孙菲菲应了一声。
之后，王老师还要去其它村走访以及通知，所以没有过多久留，急匆匆地离开了。
只等明天再一起碰面，前往牛寨村。
当天晚上，孙菲菲给爷爷打了一个电话，把这边的情况原原本本说了一遍。
电话那头沉默了两三秒，然后传来孙大夫的声音，比平时凝重一些：“菲菲，这事儿爷爷没办法为你做选择。”
他的声音微微发哑，提起往事道：“你爸妈当年去第一线当志愿的时候，我也是这么跟他们说的，但是，我希望你们时刻注意安全，不要逞强，毕竟这不是你们两个人的事情。”
孙菲菲握紧了手机，深吸了一口气道：“爷爷，我跟大壮会注意安全的。”
“照顾好自己，还有大壮也是。”孙大夫说完这句话后停顿了一下，“药材不够了就跟爷爷说，爷爷想办法给你们寄过去。”
“我知道了爷爷，您跟奶奶就放心吧，我过两天就回去。”孙菲菲淡淡一笑道。
挂了电话之后，孙菲菲在院子里站了一会儿，夜风吹动她的发梢。
王大壮坐在一旁没有出声打扰。
他非常清楚，既然王老师都亲自出面说这事儿，那就证明牛寨村的瘟疫不容小觑。
于是，伸出手跟孙菲菲握在一起，对方回头看了眼王大壮，会心一笑道：“大壮，今晚的夜色真美！”
“是呀！”王大壮也看了眼天际，繁星点点，这是在大城市里很难见到的。
两人又坐了一会儿，王大壮才拉着她的手道：“走吧，回去睡觉，明天还有一场硬仗要打！”

“嗯！”
第二天一早，王大壮和孙菲菲收拾好了行李。
他们走出院门的时候，村路上已经站了不少人。
张秀英站在最前面，穿着一件洗得发白的衬衫。
她走到王大壮面前，没有说太多话，只叮嘱了一句道：“大壮，去了那边小心点。别硬撑，该休息的时候要休息。有消息就往村里捎个话，别让大伙儿惦记着。”
王大壮点了点头道：“张姐，放心吧，我们走了之后，村里的药方和笔记都留给你们了，有不懂的就翻翻看。”
张秀英用力点了点头，没有再多说什么。
随后，在村里人不舍和关切的眼神中，王大壮和孙菲菲跟着王老师上了车。
车子发动的时候，王大壮从后视镜里看到村口树下还站着不少人。
content_en:
Chapter 212 Go to the front line of fighting the epidemic!
Wang Dazhuang and Sun Feifei looked at each other.
There is no unnecessary communication or discussion——
Wang Dazhuang saw what the other party meant, so he took the lead and said, "Teacher Wang, let's stay and fight this plague together."
Teacher Wang looked at them, was silent for a moment, and finally nodded, saying with relief: "Okay, we are very relieved to have people of your generation in Chinese medicine. In that case, we will set off early tomorrow morning, and you will be ready."
"Teacher Wang, we have no problem, let's go and clean up now." Sun Feifei responded.
After that, Teacher Wang had to visit and inform other villages, so he didn’t stay long and left in a hurry.
Just waiting to meet again tomorrow and go to Niuzhai Village.
That night, Sun Feifei called her grandfather and told her everything about the situation.
There was silence on the other end of the phone for two or three seconds, and then Dr. Sun's voice came, a little more solemn than usual: "Feifei, grandpa can't make a choice for you in this matter."
His voice was slightly hoarse as he brought up the past and said, "I told your parents the same thing when they went to volunteer on the front line. However, I hope you always pay attention to safety and don't show off. After all, this is not a matter between the two of you."
Sun Feifei clenched her phone, took a deep breath and said, "Grandpa, Da Zhuang and I will pay attention to safety."
"Take care of yourself, and Da Zhuang too." Dr. Sun paused after saying this, "If you don't have enough medicinal materials, tell grandpa, and grandpa will find a way to send them to you."
"I understand, grandpa, don't worry, you and grandma, I will go back in two days." Sun Feifei said with a faint smile.
After hanging up the phone, Sun Feifei stood in the yard for a while, the night wind blowing her hair.
Wang Dazhuang sat aside without disturbing him.
He knew very well that since Teacher Wang had personally spoken out about this, it proved that the plague in Niuzhai Village should not be underestimated.
So, he stretched out his hand and shook it with Sun Feifei. The other party looked back at Wang Dazhuang, smiled knowingly and said: "Dazhuang, the night is so beautiful tonight!"
"Yes!" Wang Dazhuang also looked at the sky, which was dotted with stars, which is difficult to see in big cities.
The two sat for a while, and then Wang Dazhuang took her hand and said, "Let's go back to bed. There is still a tough battle to be fought tomorrow!"
"Yeah!"
Early the next morning, Wang Dazhuang and Sun Feifei packed their luggage.
When they walked out of the courtyard, there were already many people standing on the village road.
Zhang Xiuying stood at the front, wearing a shirt that had been washed white.
She walked up to Wang Dazhuang and didn't say much. She just warned: "Dazhuang, be careful when you go there. Don't hold on, rest when it's time to rest. If you have any news, send a message to the village. Don't let everyone worry about it."
Wang Dazhuang nodded and said: "Sister Zhang, don't worry. After we leave, we will leave you with the village's prescriptions and notes. If you don't understand anything, just look through it."
Zhang Xiuying nodded vigorously and said nothing more.
Later, with the reluctant and concerned eyes of the villagers, Wang Dazhuang and Sun Feifei followed Teacher Wang and got into the car.
When the car started, Wang Dazhuang saw many people standing under the trees at the entrance of the village in the rearview mirror.
